ModMetaData.name: The Moat
ModMetaData.author: Keldarton
ModMetaData.description:
Forces your starting base map (and only that base) to generate with 50% impassable mountain covering the entire western half.
Features: - Left 50%: Solid, sheer impassable mountain rock with overhead mountain roof. No caves, no hollow spots, no special features inside the mountain. - Right 50%: Open flat land without mountains, hills, or lakes. All natural features spawn freely: trees, soil types, ancient dangers, Void Monolith, steam geysers, ruins, roads, and wildlife. - Only the starting base: Affects only your initial starting base map. Any future settlements, quest sites, encounter maps, or camps generate completely normal vanilla maps. - Mod Settings: Configure mountain coverage percentage, toggle ore veins in the rock wall, and customize behavior via Options -> Mod Settings.
